{{Quote|Just step out and ask them to let us pass.|Jagged Fel, ordering Baxton to speak with the Duros lieutenant|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
A [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] '''lieutenant''' served in [[Galactic Alliance Security]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. After the failed arrest of [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] and [[Bazel Warv]] by Security [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]], the Captain ordered that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], who had helped to prevent the arrest, be barred from leaving the area. The [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], along with a force of Security [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in an [[Galactic Alliance Security assault speeder|assault speeder]], blocked the limousine's path and confronted Fel's [[Pilot/Legends|driver]], [[Baxton]]. However, Atar soon arrived, and Fel, using his diplomatic immunity, requested permission to leave. Atar complied, and the Duros was forced to allow them to pass.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Looks like Atar's orders were firm.|Jaina Solo, on Atar's orders to the Duros lieutenant|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:JaggedFel-ERC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Duros attempted to stop the limousine of Jagged Fel (pictured) from leaving the Jedi Temple.]]
A young [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in [[Galactic Alliance Security]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Abyss" /> in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third installment of the series, is dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY.</ref> Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] began to develop a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] that caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors. When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] were stricken with the psychosis, they were quickly captured outside of the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple's]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] entrance by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]; [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]; their [[Solo family/Legends|daughter]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]; and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]. A nearby Security force under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]] attempted to apprehend the two Jedi, but Han, Jaina, and Fel had already taken Saav'etu and Warv to the Temple. Using Fel's diplomatic immunity, Jaina and Fel attempted to leave the scene in their [[Limousine/Legends|limousine]], and Atar, angered, ordered the Duros to prevent their departure.<ref name="Abyss" />

The Duros lieutenant, along with a number of Security [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], blocked the limousine's path in their [[Galactic Alliance Security assault speeder]]. In response, Fel sent his [[Pilot/Legends|driver]], [[Baxton]], to ask the Security forces to move. The Duros lieutenant, whose orders to prevent Fel's and Solo's departure were very strict, confronted Baxton, entering a heated argument with the driver and relentlessly refusing to allow the speeder to pass. [[Journalist/Legends|Journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] then arrived, and when it was discovered that he was using a [[Lovolol cleaning droid|cleaning droid]] to infiltrate the Jedi Temple for [[Javis Tyrr Presents: The Jedi Among Us|his show]], Atar also arrived. The Captain reassured Solo that Tyrr would not do anything illegal, but Fel requested that they be permitted to leave. Due to Fel's diplomatic immunity, Atar was forced to comply, and the Duros was ordered to move the forces out of the way.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
The Duros lieutenant was mindful of their duties and took orders very seriously. They were greatly aggravated when Baxton asked them to move and argued extensively with the driver, refusing to allow the limousine by until Atar gave the order for it to be let through.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Duros lieutenant appeared in author [[Troy Denning]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Abyss" />
